reviews.title: Game ruined by camp mechanic (updated
reviews.text:
Accidentally updated the game when I was at high level and now it set me back to barely being able to craft anything and the fact that you need to wait REAL LIFE TIME to upgrade the camp is unacceptable, I quit the game after that.

I came back to the game, and actually “gave it a try” as the developer reply told me”, I’m still not impressed and only feel more angry at how much this game has changed, managed to get to level 50 and the amount of grinding I have to do is irritating without having to pay, why can’t the developers create a “legacy” version of the game separate from this one that has no camo mechanic and plays a lot like the older version while keeping a few of the newer stuff for quality of life along with bringing back some of the story missions that were removed or shortened? Even if you have to pay for it I would rather pay to get that version of the game rather than whatever this current version is, it’s depressing, atmosphere is just ruined with all these “events”, I remember paying it in a much earlier version and the atmosphere of the game felt truly apocalyptic, while some updates were needed and welcome like being able to make decisions in combat rather than a random chance that you win or lose, but it irritates me that there is almost no other game like this and the only that’s like it is now ruined, I doubt the developers will listen because from what I read from other people who live the game and share similar opinions to me the devs don’t like hearing criticism of their game and the updates, people wouldn’t be complaining if you didn’t make these terrible chances just so you can make people spend more money on the game.

I’m so disappointed.

reviews.title: Ruined by greed.
reviews.text:
Everything you can possibly imagine about the hardcore survival nature of this game has been dumbed down and replaced by pay to win or monetized mechanics. It’s not worth your time or money anymore.

A camp that follows you everywhere isn’t a camp, it’s a menu. The entire point of building a camp in a survival game is that it’s yours, it’s somewhere, and leaving it means something. That went out the window and everything has been completely gamified. The developers totally lost the plot.

reviews.title: Dangerous.
reviews.text: So I enjoyed this game quite a bit. Survival is the main focus and you will take a serious amount of time figuring things out. Combat is meh, RNG for resources is going to hurt. No respawn resources. So if RNG says no, you have to go way out of your way for a chance of it saying no again. I got all the way to level 40 and still had a level 2 campfire. Why I say this game is dangerous is the amount of time just flies by. I’m talking real time. Next thing you know several hours has gone by and your phone is dying. Great game. I really enjoyed it, especially since they do not shove ads in your face. With how it’s implemented, I do not mind it at all since the items you get are substantially better than what you have. Devs good job. Sadly according to the story someone has put a hit on me and I had to fight enemies with grenades and shotguns with a crossbow. That’s where I drew the line. Idk what the death mechanic is. Yet I know that I was technically soft locked if I could not upgrade my camp. I already cleared out 9 towns… other than that. Hope you guys have better luck than I did. Thanks again devs for the great experience.

reviews.title: They destroyed the game
reviews.text: I love the game, I’ve spent a lot of money and played for a very very long time, the change to the crafting system making it be a camp you need to upgrade is horrible, I’m done with the change but I was max crafting level at least being me back to where I was instead of having to level up from 0 again, bring back the old crafting system.

The game is very fun, my only thing I think needs some kind of change is the cities. I travel a lot in the game just to get supplies because I’m doing one of the scientist quests for EMBA (I think that’s what it’s called) and I hate having to spend ages traveling further and further to loot cities for things to help craft.

reviews.title: Paywalls just for completing quests?
reviews.text: I’ve been a player on this game for years as I have been on and off the game. Yet when I came to play again and come back to the game I see daily quests getting put behind paywalls. It is becoming very apparent that the developers don’t actually care about their game anymore and are just finding ways to rake in more money. I have been seeing the game slowly become more and more unplayable as time goes on. It is really sad considering that I loved this game and thought it was a cool concept. Instead of adding cool content or just stoping the updates all together. The developers have turned to overpricing everything. Which will only out price their loyal customers in the long run.
